name: iceman-contributor-free
_comment: OpenCode Go model (https://opencode.ai/docs/go/): free for a limited time with unlimited usage on both Go and Go Plus (id iceman-contributor-free, released 2026-10-24, stealth model). Text-only input, not VL. Contributor model: prompts and completions are used to improve the model (training: Yes, retention: Not ZDR) - enable only if that is acceptable, same class as the Muse Spark contributor entries. Limits per models.dev: 256K context, 128K output.
